about: What the phone apps sell (docs/plan.md slice 15; docs/tasks.md, "Monetisation"): Pro, one auto-renewing subscription, and the tip jar, whose tips unlock nothing; nothing paid reaches the game. The one source for tools/store/store.py, which writes apple/QuestPump.storekit, checks the ids both apps name and applies this file to App Store Connect and Google Play. Prices are USD; the money values (the prices, the trials, no weekly and no lifetime plan) are David's call 2: a month free on the yearly plan, and since 2026-10-09 a week free on the monthly plan (David approved it). Apple caps a display name at 30 characters and a description at 45, so Pro carries a shorter description for Apple; Play takes up to 200. A plan's level is its rank in Apple's subscription group (1 first), its trial an introductory free trial on Apple and the offer play_offer on its Play base plan. apple.group_reference is the group's reference name in App Store Connect (never shown; store.py finds the group by the plans' product ids, and by this name only before a plan exists). The grace periods keep a paying subscriber's Pro while the store retries a failed renewal (the apps already count it): Apple's Billing Grace Period, one setting for every subscription of the app, for all renewals in production and sandbox; Play's on each base plan. The desktop helper builds in the bundle id, the package, the Pro product ids and play.license_key to check a paired phone's Pro proof (docs/plan.md slice 35, "Pro on the computer"), so a change reaches the computer with the next helper release. play.license_key is the app's licensing key, a public value: the base64 of an RSA-2048 SubjectPublicKeyInfo with the exponent 65537, copied from Play Console (Monetize with Play, Monetization setup, Licensing) on 2026-10-09; without it every Play proof is refused, and store.py --check refuses any other key. apple.notifications is the production URL of the App Store Server Notifications V2, the sync Worker's (docs/plan.md slice 64), which store.py asc sets in App Store Connect. The web block (slice 64) sells the same plans and trials on questpump.com through Paddle Billing, as merchant of record: web.paddle.environment is sandbox until Pluxia's live Paddle account sells, client_token Paddle.js's client-side token on /pro, and prices each plan's Paddle price id (pro_ and the plan), each null until Pluxia's live Paddle account makes it and set only while the environment is live (a sandbox test runs from a local copy of this file, so a test card never unlocks Pro), which keeps every Get Pro hidden until then; the sync Worker (site/sync/src/facts.js) builds this file in and counts a Paddle subscription as Pro only by those prices, and only live. web.pro_token_keys holds the public P-256 JWKs (by kid) of the Pro token the sync Worker signs and every device checks offline; site/sync/scripts/pro-token-key.mjs made the first pair on 2026-10-31 (kid irwBYFPU...), and a device ignores a token whose kid its build does not list. web.pro_token holds the token's header typ and its iss and aud claims, as contract/sync-api.yaml's ProTokenHeader and ProTokenClaims define them: the Worker signs them and every device refuses a token without exactly these, so nothing else the key might sign, and no token meant for another audience, passes (2026-11-01). store.py --check refuses a malformed id, a Paddle id outside the live environment, any private key there, and a key repeated in one object (the desktop helper's reader would refuse the whole file).
